activities.name: Running
activities.description: Running is a great cardiovascular exercise that helps improve endurance, strengthen the heart, and burn calories. It’s a dynamic, full-body workout suitable for all fitness levels.

activities.name: Yoga
activities.description: Yoga enhances flexibility, balance, and mindfulness through a series of poses and stretches. It’s ideal for relieving stress and improving posture.

activities.name: Cycling
activities.description: Cycling is an intense cardiovascular workout that helps build leg strength, stamina, and endurance. It’s great for calorie burning and can be done outdoors or indoors.

activities.name: Swimming
activities.description: Swimming is an excellent full-body workout that targets multiple muscle groups, improves cardiovascular health, and provides low-impact exercise.

activities.name: Weightlifting
activities.description: Weightlifting builds muscle strength, endurance, and power by lifting various weights. It's ideal for boosting metabolism and increasing muscle mass.

activities.name: Jump Rope
activities.description: Jumping rope is an effective exercise that improves cardiovascular health, coordination, and overall strength. It’s also great for burning calories quickly.
